note: Round 3 (operator, 2026-10-05): a library of iconic, concrete sounds not tied to a colour (the operator places them later), plus the land types and moments still missing. Prompt style from research: name the physical source and action literally, front-loaded, then recording descriptors; no abstract mood words ('ethereal', 'magical shimmer'), which is what made rounds 1-2 wispy. Sources: Stable Audio Open model card (better at sound effects and field recordings than music; English descriptions), Jordi Pons 'On prompting Stable Audio' ('High-quality', '44.1kHz', 'Stereo' lift fidelity because much of the data is low-rate), diffusers docs (negative 'low quality, average quality'). Generated at 3 s and trimmed by finish.py, so an event is never cut off by a 1 s window.
negative: low quality, average quality, muffled, lo-fi, noise, hiss, distortion, clipping, music, melody, speech, voice, vocals, reverb wash
